description: Misfits is a UK-born plant-based protein bar brand now selling in the US via eatmisfits.com, with plant-based and Stuffed bar ranges. Tiers: Level 1 Sweet 20%, Level 2 Sweeter 25% after 10+ sales/month, Level 3 Sweetest 30% after 25+ sales/month. Tracked via Upfluence dashboard. No cap wording on the page, so commission_cap is unknown.

New-program evidence: 'Bonuses start 1 November 2026 (quarterly bonuses start with January-March 2027)' and 'The first year covers sales from 1 November 2026 to 31 December 2027' for the top-seller trip/$6,000 bonus — the US Sweet Squad is newly launching and actively recruiting, requiring only 1,500+ followers on TikTok or Instagram and US residence.

description: North American mushroom supplement company (offices in Chicago and Vancouver) selling Life Force 7, an organic 7-species fruiting-body mushroom powder that is SGS-tested in Canada at 41.5% beta-glucans, plus PetShrooms 7 for dogs and cats. Its ambassador program has no minimum follower count and reviews applications personally within three business days.

evidence.summary: Official ambassador page: 20% commission on every order through link or code, 30-day cookie, monthly payouts via Shopify Collabs, free product and a personalised 20% audience discount code. Exact cap wording in the Earn step: '20% commission on every sale, paid out monthly. No caps, no tiers, no surprises.' — this explicit 'No caps' statement is the basis for commission_cap = uncapped.

Program presents as small and actively recruiting: 'NO MIN. Follower count doesn't matter. Engagement does.', 'We review every application personally within 3 business days. Most fit-aligned creators are accepted.', and a named human contact (partners@ifungi.com) — evidence of a small/new program, supporting creator_saturation = low.

description: Cometeer is a Massachusetts-based coffee company that brews specialty coffee from partner roasters, flash-freezes it into capsules, and sells it by subscription for melt-to-make drinks at home. Its affiliate program pays commission on first-time customer purchases over $35 tracked by link or promo code.

evidence.summary: Official Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions (Effective Date: 4/10/2025): 'You will receive a commission of 20% per qualifying sale tracked through your unique affiliate link or promo code.' Qualifying sales are >$35 and first-time purchases from new customers. Paid monthly via Tremendous. No cap wording in the terms, so commission_cap is unknown.

HypeAuditor data cited: 55 Instagram mentions from 44 creators, including 37 organic posts — active creator use, but no creator-count evidence strong enough to claim low or high saturation, so saturation is unknown.
